lines.text: Mark out an area 40 m long by 30 m wide. Play 6 v 6, no goalkeepers, for 18 minutes. [ILLUSTRATIVE: session value, a test value]

At one end, mark a full-width end zone 6 m deep, and a full-width line 12 m from that end line. [ILLUSTRATIVE: a schematic 12 m from the escaping team's end line, for this 40 m area only; ILLUSTRATIVE: a schematic 6 m depth for the end zone, for this 40 m area only]

lines.marker: [A: Christian's approved wording POSSESSION_CONTINUES, received 25 October 2026 | contingent on Q6]
lines.text: When possession changes, play carries on without a stoppage, and each team keeps attacking the same target.

Start, and restart after each point, with an escaping player on the ball near their own end, outside the end zone, where you choose. You may also restart this way whenever you judge an attempt has run its course, for example when the escaping team holds the ball beyond the line unpressed.

If the ball goes over an end line, the team that did not touch it last restarts from the feet: the escaping team as at the start, the pressing team on the marked line, where you choose. Throw-ins and free kicks as normal; no offside.

lines.marker: [C | contingent on Q1 | contingent on Q2]
lines.text: The escaping team scores a point when it escapes the pressing team pressing together: a player dribbles over the line, or receives and controls a ball played over it, and the team keeps the ball through its next action. One player closing down alone does not necessarily count as pressing together. No point if play stops first; use your judgment for unusual stoppages.
The pressing team scores a point when a player dribbles into the end zone, or receives and controls the ball inside it. Points from both roles add up; most points wins.

lines.marker: [P | PROPOSED Q1 | PROPOSED Q2 | PROPOSED Q5]
lines.text: The team defending that end is the escaping team; the other is the pressing team. Swap roles when you choose: the teams change ends and the markings stay.

lines.text: Continue progressing while under immediate pressure. (the Learning Goal's Coach Definition, verbatim)

lines.text: Help your players stay connected under pressure, recognize escape opportunities, and play beyond the press while keeping the attack alive. (verbatim, read from the RPC library)
